description: This file contains initialization code for the i.MX8MM6 SoC, including RDC (Resource Domain Controller) setup and clock configuration for the M4 core and related peripherals.

methods.name: SOC_RdcInit
methods.description: Initializes the RDC by assigning the M4 core to domain 1 and enabling clocks for various peripherals and PLL sources.

methods.name: SOC_ClockInit
methods.description: Configures system clocks, including switching root muxes, initializing PLLs, and enabling clocks for peripherals.

methods.name: nxp_mimx8mm6_init
methods.description: Main initialization function called at system startup to set up RDC and clocks.
